name: Vaporwave aesthetic (early 2010s)
lineage: Early-2010s internet-distributed electronic subgenre characterized by slowed-down chopped-and-screwed sampling of 1980s-1990s American smooth-jazz, Muzak, corporate-advertising music, and Japanese city-pop, with explicit ironic-melancholic engagement with consumer-capitalist visual-aesthetic. Macintosh Plus's Floral Shoppe (2011), Chuck Person's Eccojams Vol. 1 (2010), and the broader Beer on the Rug netlabel scene anchor the canonical vaporwave aesthetic.
